description: This file defines middleware functions for an Express.js application, including request logging, 404 not found handling, and centralized error handling with standardized JSON responses.

methods.name: auditLoggerMiddleware
methods.description: Middleware that logs request start and end events with trace ID, method, URL, user ID, and status.

methods.name: notFoundHandler
methods.description: Handler for 404 Not Found responses, returning a standardized JSON payload.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Centralized error handler that maps various error types to appropriate HTTP status codes and JSON error responses.
